items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: That was with, you know, Raymond Boyk and Charlie DuPont.

ctx.x: I know his brother Bill too. He's a good bass player. Yeah, he's fine. Well, that Club Plantation must have been a good band.
Oh, that was a good band. Oh, that was a good band. That was with, you know, Raymond Boyk and Charlie DuPont. The piano man was, let's see. I could see him right in front of me.
Was that before they had Chavez or after? No, it was, yeah, it was Julius Chavez, that's right. Oh, he was the one. Yeah.
